name: 开源视频工程
description: Create an editable local video project and export an MP4 with the pinned Hyperframes renderer.
description_zh: 在本机 OpenMotion 源码运行时里创建可编辑工程，并用锁定的 Hyperframes 渲染导出 MP4。
description_en: Create an editable project in a local OpenMotion checkout and export an MP4 with pinned Hyperframes.
examples_zh: 检查本机是否已有可用的渲染依赖
用中文文案和几何图形做一段二十秒成片
把当前工程导出为 MP4 并做技术校验
examples_en: Check whether this machine can render
Make a twenty second film from Chinese copy and geometry
Export the current project to MP4 and verify it
